Cost: 1,500eb (V. Expensive)
Type: Cyberarm (Foundational)
Install: Hospital
Humanity Loss: 14 (4d6)
Option Slots: uses 0, provides 1

Cyberarm. Borgware. 1 Option Slot, for Cyberhand Options only. Comes with a Projectile Launch System (PLS) pre-installed that costs no Humanity Loss and takes no Option Slot, fitted with a non-removable Drum Magazine that raises its capacity to 6. If the PLS fired in the previous Round it can't fire this one, because its slow autoloader needs the whole Round. Once the PLS is drawn, stowing it takes an Action. Below BODY 9 the arm costs 1 MOVE and gives -1 to every check involving it or anything installed in it, weapons included. The arm is always recognizable as a Cyberarm, even under Realskinn.

Foundry notes:

  • The pre-installed PLS is described here rather than installed as a separate item. 0.92.4 has no Projectile Launch System item; use its Popup Grenade Launcher if you want one on the sheet.
  • The sheet won't restrict the Option Slot to Cyberhand Options, and the BODY 9 penalty is applied by hand.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Cyberware > Cyberarms).
